baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of belief, intentional sound action, covering of bad acts, and recompense by the best of practiced action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust becomes intentional sound-making; divine action then treats the two sides asymmetrically: ugliness is effaced under cover, while recompense is raised to the best and beneficent register of the work.

activation_trace.role: Heart-settling assent supplies the inward trust embodied by the following work.
Intentional action, repeated before and inside the reward clause, makes practiced agency the mechanism's carrier.
Soundness against corruption defines the work as repair rather than generic activity.
Effacing sin by covering it supplies the explicit removal operation applied to bad acts.
Ugliness and badness identify what is removed rather than what sets the reward's scale.
Act-for-act recompense supplies the answering movement toward the agent.
Excellent beneficence, including increase beyond bare justice, supplies the upward measure of best.

changed_reading.before: Believers receive forgiveness and a reward for good deeds.
changed_reading.after: Trust embodied as intentional repair yields an asymmetric settlement: badness is effaced, while recompense is assessed upward through the best and beneficent quality of practiced work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of removal with recompense and the phrase naming the best of what they used to do.
baseline_models.mechanism: The standing-in-place branch of recompense lets the best function as a representative measure for the oeuvre after its bad side is covered; the verse can therefore profile a person by the best sustained strand rather than average every act.

activation_trace.role: Repeated intentional work supplies a body of acts from which a representative measure can be drawn.
Occurrence through past time gives the final work-clause the texture of a sustained profile.
Effacement by covering removes the bad strand from the operative profile.
One thing standing in place of another supplies representative assessment rather than a simple itemized payment.
Goodness against ugliness supplies the selected register that can characterize the whole practice.

changed_reading.before: Every deed is entered into a flat item-by-item ledger.
changed_reading.after: Once the bad strand is removed, the best sustained strand may stand as the representative basis on which the person's work is answered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence turns professed trust into material that is assayed, realized as truthful performance, and exerted under hardship before the focus promise arrives; belief plus sound work is therefore an exposed and embodied quality, not a verbal membership label.

activation_trace.role: Assaying metal or a person makes the verbal faith claim a quality exposed under trial.
Making a promise or action come true supplies the transition from claim to verified performance.
Expenditure of capacity under hardship gives the immediate embodied form of tested trust.
Settled assent remains the focus anchor whose quality the preceding assay exposes.
Intentional action carries the disclosed trust into the promise's qualification and measure.

structural_cues: 29:2-7 moves from a claim of belief, through testing and truth-disclosure, to strenuous self-directed action and then the focus promise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, realized truth, and exertion; I infer that this sequence converts inward assent into assessable work before the promise. A live alternative is that the trials merely surround, rather than define, the focus category.

changed_reading.before: The verse addresses everyone bearing a static believer label.
changed_reading.after: The verse addresses trust that has survived exposure and become intentional, sound performance; covering and reward answer disclosed quality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reconciliation branch of soundness is sharpened by two difficult relations: goodness toward parents stops at obedience into false association, while the best mode of intertwined dispute is oriented toward shared surrender. Sound action becomes boundary-preserving repair rather than appeasement.

activation_trace.role: Removal of estrangement supplies a relational sense for the focus's sound actions.
Beneficent excellence supplies a mode that can exceed bare reciprocity without erasing boundaries.
Connecting one thing to another supplies the durable parental bond within which good conduct is required.
Obedient submission, explicitly withheld here, supplies the limit that keeps relational goodness from becoming capitulation.
Intertwined dispute supplies the resistant social material on which the best manner must work.
Beneficent excellence used as a manner of disputation makes best a relational practice rather than a score.
Peace and reconciliation supply the horizon of repair while the verse preserves disagreement and an exception for wrongdoing.

structural_cues: 29:8 pairs goodness to parents with refusal of wrongful obedience; 29:46 pairs the best form of disputation with shared confession and an exception for injustice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enduring relation, withheld obedience, intertwined dispute, excellence, and reconciliation; I infer that these specify a bounded repair mechanism for salihat. A live alternative is that the two contexts exemplify separate duties without defining the focus plural.

changed_reading.before: Sound deeds are private merits or conflict-avoiding niceness.
changed_reading.after: Sound deeds can be acts that repair relation by beneficent means while retaining truth-bearing limits against coercion and wrongdoing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact belief-and-sound-action qualification reappears and moves from sound acts to entry among sound persons. Covering and recompense can thus be read as a transition from a defect-marked record into an incorporated identity and company.

activation_trace.role: Soundness against corruption supplies the quality first attached to actions.
Effacement of bad acts supplies removal of what obstructs the transition.
Recompense supplies the answering outcome that the next repeated formula spatializes.
The move from sound actions to sound persons supplies an action-to-identity shift.
Entry into an inside supplies incorporation rather than merely external credit.

structural_cues: 29:9 repeats the focus's belief-plus-sound-action protasis and replaces the paired outcomes with entry among the sound.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition followed by entry and a shift from deeds to persons; I infer that 29:9 unfolds the social or identity result of 29:7. A live alternative is that it is a parallel promise rather than an explication of the earlier one.

changed_reading.before: Covering and payment leave the recipient externally unchanged.
changed_reading.after: The two divine actions participate in moving the recipient into the inside and company of the sound, so repaired practice becomes incorporated identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Self-directed striving and the failed proposal to carry another's errors make moral ownership nondelegable; the following stacked weights show attempted transfer adding liability instead. Divine covering in the focus is therefore an exceptional release no peer can perform, while recompense stays tied to owned action.

activation_trace.role: The self or thing itself makes striving's yield return to the actor who exerts it.
Effacing bad acts supplies a divine removal operation distinct from shifting their load to another person.
Recompense answering an act keeps the positive outcome attached to its agent.
Repeated intentional agency anchors both qualification and outcome in what these people themselves do.
Bearing an entrusted burden supplies the proposed assumption of another person's moral load.
Sin and error identify the proposed cargo whose transfer the ayah denies.
Repeated physical weights make liability additive and stubbornly attached rather than erased by a claim.

structural_cues: 29:6 assigns striving's benefit to the self; 29:12 denies the promised transfer of errors; 29:13 replaces transfer with accumulated burdens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-return, denied carriage, sins as cargo, and added weights; I infer a contrast between impossible human reassignment and the focus's divine effacement. A live alternative is that 29:12-13 only refutes one fraudulent claim and does not specify takfir's mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a generalized group grant whose moral material might be shifted among people.
changed_reading.after: Each person's intentional practice remains owned and answerable; bad acts are released by divine effacement, not outsourced, and good recompense returns to its actor.

context_deltas.mechanism: Actions can be made to look good while functionally diverting their agents; later, effective practice is identified by restraining manifest ugliness, and best names a manner of engagement. The focus's best is therefore tested by corrective and relational effect, not surface attractiveness.

activation_trace.role: Soundness against corruption supplies the focus's functional criterion.
Beneficent excellence supplies a positive standard deeper than attractive appearance.
Making something appear good supplies cosmetic enhancement that can mask failed work.
Intentional works are the very objects beautified, creating a direct counterimage to the focus's works.
Turning aside supplies the functional failure hidden beneath the beautified actions.
Manifest ugliness names what effective practice must inhibit, giving soundness an observable effect.
Beneficent excellence as a manner of disputation makes best an enacted relation rather than decoration.

structural_cues: 29:38 joins beautified works to path-diversion; 29:45 judges practice by restraint of ugliness; 29:46 applies best to the manner of disputation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attractive presentation, misdirection, restraint of ugliness, and excellent engagement; I infer that these discriminate intrinsic soundness from cosmetic goodness in 29:7. A live alternative is that 29:38 condemns only the works' object, not appearance as a criterion.

changed_reading.before: The best works are simply the most impressive-looking or highest-ranked specimens.
changed_reading.after: Best names work whose soundness appears in what it prevents, repairs, and how it engages resistance, even when misdirected work has been made attractive.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later repetition of the focus qualification concretizes reward as being settled into a lasting abode, then names patient self-restraint and reliance as the actors' temporal posture. The best of what they used to do becomes durable fidelity rather than an isolated peak act.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence through time supplies the habitual horizon of what they used to do.
Repeated intentional action carries that temporal horizon from qualification into reward.
Recompense supplies the abstract outcome later rendered as stable emplacement.
Taking or assigning a lodging turns recompense into settled habitation.
Persistence not quickly reached by decay supplies durability to the promised settlement.
Holding the self against panic supplies the sustained discipline behind the repeated work-formula.
Reliant trust supplies the continuing orientation paired with patient practice.

structural_cues: 29:58 repeats belief and sound action, names the reward of workers, and renders it as lodging with permanence; 29:59 immediately identifies patience and reliance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated qualification, lodging, permanence, patience, and reliance; I infer that these concretize both the reward and the temporal grain of the focus's past-progressive work. A live alternative is that they specify a later reward without redefining best in 29:7.

changed_reading.before: Reward is a one-time transaction keyed to a standout act.
changed_reading.after: Reward is durable emplacement answering a practiced trajectory whose excellence consists in patient, reliant fidelity over time.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it spatializes two moral verbs through a late sanctuary scene; it remains anchored in the focus roots for trust-security and covering and in their actual co-occurrence at 29:67 with sanctuary and snatching. Render it as a controlled lexical-spatial analogy, not as a claim that takfir literally means sanctuary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins believing with a divine covering-away of bad acts; both roots recur together in the secure-sanctuary reversal of 29:67.

activation_trace.role: Security and trusted calm supply a protective spatial undertone to believing.
Literal covering supplies the enclosing operation applied to the believers' bad acts.
A bounded sanctuary supplies the concrete protected inside for the analogy.
The paired secure and believing occurrences place physical safety and committed trust in one lexical field.
Swift snatching supplies the exposed outside against which protective covering becomes legible.
Covering or denying blessing reverses the focus operation: recipients cover received good while God covers their bad.

changed_reading.before: Belief is abstract assent and takfir is abstract cancellation.
changed_reading.after: Believing can be imagined as alignment with a secure inside, while divine covering shelters the person from the exposed aftermath of bad acts, in pointed reversal of covering over received blessing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the seed-covering branch of k-f-r with the packet's form-distant j-z-y to j-z-z split and a later earth-revival scene. It remains anchored in two focus verbs and exact packet branches, but downstream prose should label it a material growth analogy rather than a lexical translation or disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places sound intentional acts beside covering and recompense, whose supplied branch inventories include covered seed and ripeness for cutting.

activation_trace.role: Fitness and suitability supply the viability of the intentional acts treated as seed-like material.
Covering seed with soil supplies concealment as a condition of later growth rather than mere disappearance.
The split j-z-z image of ripeness for cutting supplies a form-distant harvest timing to the recompense verb.
Delivery of water supplies the activating input that makes concealed potential productive.
Earth revived by rain and plants supplies the emergence of life from apparently inert ground.
Dead land supplies the prior exhausted state reversed by water and renewed growth.

changed_reading.before: Bad acts are deleted and good acts are paid out in a purely administrative operation.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material model, badness is covered while viable sound work is concealed, revived, and gathered at ripeness; recompense looks like realized yield rather than a flat transfer.

strongest_changes: The opening assay sequence turned belief plus work from a static label into tested, embodied trust.
The repeated formula in 29:9 changed external accounting into entry among the sound.
Self-return, denied carriage of errors, and accumulated weights made moral ownership nontransferable and divine covering exceptional.
Beautified but path-blocking works separated cosmetic goodness from the focus's functionally corrective best.
The repetition in 29:58-59 rendered recompense as durable habitation answering patient, reliant practice.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrences produced reversals around the focus lexemes: appearance versus sound effect, private merit versus bounded repair and incorporation, abstract payment versus habitation, and secure belief versus covering blessing. The split recompense inventory also preserved a contained harvest analogy that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the standing-in-place branch of recompense licenses representative assessment or only remains a lexical possibility.
Whether 29:9 and 29:58 deliberately unfold 29:7 or function as parallel promises with related wording.
The sanctuary and harvest readings remain controlled analogies, not lexical disambiguations.
